analyst_view.overall: Bottom side Gladbach (one win under Alexander Blessin) host Dortmund, 2nd, unbeaten and level on 21 points with Bayern. Gladbach are without the banned Itakura and the injured Kleindienst, Leopold, Leszczynski, Ullrich and, per Bulinews, Hashioka; goalkeeper Nicolas is fit again. Only Bolin and Ullrich move the numbers' goals, and Kleindienst has been out for weeks, so his absence is largely in Gladbach's form. For Dortmund, Can, Konstantelias, Lerma and Chukwuemeka are out, while Guirassy (thigh strain) and Anton (muscle problems) are doubtful: Niko Kovac said it is 'not ruled out' they play and that whoever is fit will play, and the Bundesliga's predicted lineup includes both, so this morning's rotation worry looks smaller. Robert Hartmann referees and his record is close to average.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals, already taking Bolin and Ullrich off Gladbach. I lean 2% lower, to about 2.7: Guirassy is still only doubtful after his thigh strain and Gladbach's attack lacks Kleindienst. I cut this morning's -3 because Kovac says whoever is fit will play, so heavy rotation before the Champions League looks unlikely.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, already nudged up for Dortmund's recent count (37 in six). Gladbach plan to defend in a back three and break, which the numbers already expect, so I stay at 9.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards and already add a big 22% for Gladbach's recent card spike (21 in six), including Itakura's yellow-red that bans him here. Blessin wants an aggressive game in a full stadium, but that is the same pattern the numbers already add for, and referee Hartmann (4.0 a game) is close to average, so I stay at 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.2 shots, already lifted for both sides' recent shooting. With Kovac planning to play his fit first-choice players and Guirassy possibly back, the Dortmund rotation I allowed for this morning looks less likely, so I move from -3 to no change, at 28.2.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target. Guirassy's doubtful status and Gladbach's missing captain Kleindienst point a little lower, but less rotation risk for Dortmund softens it, so I go 2% lower, to about 9.4 (was -3).
